job.job_description:
Experience: 24 Years
Education: Any Graduate (B.E./B.Tech, MCA, M.Tech, M.Sc. (CS/IT), BCA, BCS, B.Sc. (CS/IT), or equivalent preferred)
Location: Pune (Work From Office)
Department: Data Science Analytics
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Industry: IT Services Consulting
Language: Fluency in English, Hindi, and Marathi
Key Responsibilities:
Design and develop AI workflows using LangGraph and LangChain.
Integrate AWS Bedrock foundation models for document processing, entity extraction, classification, and conversational AI.
Develop scalable backend services and microservices using Python and Java.
Build multi-step AI agents with conditional workflows, tool integrations, and human-in-the-loop capabilities.
Work with DynamoDB and other AWS services to manage AI workflow data and application state.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver AI-driven business solutions.
Optimize AI models and workflows for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, and cloud technologies.
Required Skills:
24 years of experience in AI/ML or backend software development.
Strong proficiency in Python and Java.
Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph.
Experience with AWS Bedrock, DynamoDB, and other AWS cloud services.
Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI applications.
Experience in building REST APIs and microservices.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
Compensation
Salary will be based on interview performance, technical expertise, and relevant experience.
